title: C15 artemisinin: the aldehyde is the branch point.
C15 artemisinin: aldehyde에서 갈라지는 경로.
intro: Follow CYP71AV1, DBR2 and ALDH1, then read the separate late oxidative chemistry.
CYP71AV1·DBR2·ALDH1을 따라간 뒤 후기 산화 화학을 별도로 살펴보세요.

edges.label: Amorpha-diene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A fully assigned amorpha-4,11-diene reference is shown. This is a scaffold-forming step, not the complete artemisinin pathway.

edges.label: AaCYP71AV1 + CPR · C12 hydroxylation
edges.detail: Characterised Artemisia annua P450 chemistry; redox partner supplies electrons.
edges.detailKo: 규명된 Artemisia annua P450 반응입니다. Redox partner가 전자를 공급합니다.

edges.label: AaCYP71AV1 + CPR · oxidation
edges.detail: CYP71AV1 supports sequential C12 oxidation in engineered yeast. AaADH1 provides an additional characterised alcohol-oxidation route.
edges.detailKo: CYP71AV1은 재조합 효모에서 연속 C12 산화를 수행합니다. AaADH1은 별도로 규명된 alcohol 산화 경로를 제공합니다.

edges.label: AaCYP71AV1 / AaALDH1 · acid branch
edges.detail: Alternative enzymes can oxidise this aldehyde to the unsaturated acid; this is a branch competing with aldehyde reduction.
edges.detailKo: 여러 효소가 이 aldehyde를 불포화 acid로 산화할 수 있습니다. Aldehyde 환원과 경쟁하는 분기입니다.

edges.label: AaDBR2 · 11(13) reduction · NADPH
edges.detail: DBR2 is an enoate reductase acting on the unsaturated aldehyde, not a direct artemisinic-acid-to-DHAA enzyme.
edges.detailKo: DBR2는 불포화 aldehyde의 11(13) 이중결합을 환원합니다. Artemisinic acid를 DHAA로 직접 환원하는 효소가 아닙니다.

edges.label: AaALDH1 · aldehyde oxidation
edges.detail: Recombinant AaALDH1 catalyses NAD(P)+-dependent oxidation of the dihydro aldehyde to its acid.
edges.detailKo: 재조합 AaALDH1은 NAD(P)+ 의존적으로 dihydro aldehyde를 acid로 산화합니다.

edges.label: O2-driven autoxidation · several stages
edges.detail: Experimentally demonstrated nonenzymatic oxidative chemistry via peroxide intermediates. This condensed connection is not a single characterised enzyme reaction.
edges.detailKo: Peroxide 중간체를 거치는 비효소적 산화 화학이 실험으로 확인됐습니다. 요약 연결이며 단일 효소 반응이 아닙니다.
